title: Build CASCADE×Meta overlay → rebuild index_auto → run CI v1.1
abstract: Generate overlay panel/metrics/summary for CASCADE×Meta mapping; rebuild Atlas index_auto; run CI v1.1 to confirm entry.

original_submission.content:
import sys, json
sys.path.append('storage/shared/atlas/tools')
import build_cascade_meta_overlay, build_index_auto, ci_validate
# Build overlay artifacts
build_cascade_meta_overlay.main()
# Rebuild index and run CI
ia_path, n = build_index_auto.build()
out = ci_validate.run()
print(json.dumps({
    "index_auto": ia_path,
    "entries_scanned": n,
    "ci_entries_found": out.get("entries_found"),
    "ci_ok": out.get("ok"),
    "ci_with_errors": out.get("with_errors"),
    "report_json": "storage/shared/atlas/edges/ci_validation_report.json",
    "report_txt": "storage/shared/atlas/edges/ci_validation_report.txt"
}))
